entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Criminal Petition No.6723 Of 2025
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS)
by the petitioners/accused Nos.1, 2 and 4, seeking anticipatory bail, in connection with Crime No.44 of 2025 of Central Crime Station, Hyderabad, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 406 and 420 read with 34 of I.P.C.
2.
Heard Sri C.Hari Preeth, learned counsel for the petitioners and Sri Syed Yasar Mamoon, learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for respondent-State.

3. Ms.Basham Shobha Rani has lodged a complaint before the police stating that M/s. Reliance Developers, represented by its authorized Designated C.E.O., has entered into an agreement of sale with her vide dated 29.01.2019 regarding Flat bearing No.102 on First Floor with built up area of 1900 square feet with 71 square yards of undivided share of land out of 710.25 square yards in the premises bearing H.No.1-10-38/2, situated at Begumpet, Hyderabad and paid substantial amount.

Petitioner No.1 and his son failed to register the Flat on the other hand ::2::
BRMR, J Crlp_6723_2025 they threatened her with dire consequences and prayed to take action according to law.

Basing on the said complaint a case in Crime No.190 of 2022, dated 14.04.2022 was registered by the Jubilee Hills Police Station,
Hyderabad, for the offences punishable under Sections 420 and 406 read with 34 of IPC against the petitioners and accused No.3.
Subsequently, on the point of jurisdiction, the said case was transferred to Punjagutta Police Station, Hyderabad and renumbered as F.I.R.No.550 of 2022, dated 18.10.2022.
Later, as per the instructions of the Superior Officers, the said case was again transferred to Central Crime Station, Hyderabad and re-numbered as F.I.R.No.44 of 2025, dated 10.04.2025.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the police had issued a notice under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C. to the petitioners/accused Nos.1, 2 and 4 and they gave suitable reply on 29.05.2025.
5. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor has not disputed the issuance of notice under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C. and the reply submitted by the petitioners.

State of Bihar 1.
7.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is made clear that the petitioners/accused Nos.1, 2 and 4 shall cooperate with the Investigating Officer for the investigation and they shall make themselves available as and when they called for by the Investigating Officer.
If the petitioners/accused Nos.1, 2 and 4 failed to cooperate with the Investigating Officer for investigation, the Investigating Officer is at liberty to take action against them according to law.
8. With the above observations, this Criminal Petition is disposed of.
_ _ B.R.MADHUSUDHAN RAO, J Date: 04.06.2025

Note:
Issue C.C. by day after tomorrow.
